summary: Nanobiotix S.A. filed a Form 6-K on May 26, 2026, announcing the closing of a global offering of ordinary shares, including ADSs and pre-funded warrants. The offering raised approximately $100 million in gross proceeds at a price of €33.60 per ordinary share ($38.98 per ADS), representing a 14.92% discount to the volume-weighted average price. Proceeds are allocated to platform development and corporate purposes. This is a routine equity capital raise, not a special situation.
